subject: Recap & proposed commitment structure + startup incentive request
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
To: Sam Perez <sam@avery.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 18 Oct 2026 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Recap & proposed commitment structure + startup incentive request

Sam — great to meet earlier today. Quick recap of what we heard and a lightweight proposal to align on next steps.

Call highlights (high level)
- Primary goal: reduce per-token inference costs for customer-facing assistants while keeping p95 latency under 300ms.
- Expected steady-state consumption: ~10M tokens/month (text generation + embeddings) with monthly peaks to ~18M.
- Procurement window: decision target late Oct / PO early Nov if the economics work.
- Legal + security: minimal custom terms; they want SOC2 evidence and a simple MSA.

A few concrete asks from your side
- Target blended $/1M tokens around $70–75 to fit the FY27 budget.
- Interest in a 12-month committed-use agreement with the option to extend multi-year if we can hit a lower blended rate.
- Request for startup program support (credits or accelerated discounts) while ramping.

Attached: redwood-commitment-proposal-v1.pdf (draft commitment tiers) and SOW-template.docx referenced on the call.

Proposed next steps
1) Confirm the baseline month we should use for sizing (is 10M tokens/month correct?)
2) I’ll circulate a one-page priced commitment that shows list vs committed prices and the startup credit applied.
3) If numbers look good, legal + procurement loop in and we target PO by 2026-11-05.

Can you confirm baseline and whether a 12-month firm commit is acceptable as the initial term?

Thanks,

Jasmine Liu
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwood.com | (415) 555-0123
Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood-commitment-proposal-v1.pdf (pdf, 3 pages)
Attachment: SOW-template.docx (docx, 1 page)

From: Sam Perez <sam@avery.ai>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
Cc: Avery Labs Procurement <procurement@avery.ai>
Date: Mon, 19 Oct 2026 09:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Recap & proposed commitment structure + startup incentive request

Jasmine — thanks for the recap and for the PDF. Quick answers:
- Baseline of 10M tokens/month is correct for planning (ramp profile: months 1–3 at ~4–6M, months 4–6 at ~8–12M, steady at ~10M with occasional spikes).
- We can commit to a 12-month firm term if the blended $/1M token figure lands in the low $70s.
- Procurement timeline: aim to have economics signed-off by 11/03 so we can issue a PO by 11/10.

On incentives: as a Series A startup we need an up-front startup credit (applied to first 2–3 months) and a clear committed discount schedule. If you can get us to a blended ~$70/1M tokens given our expected banding, we’ll push the PO earlier.

Would appreciate seeing a priced example that shows: list price vs committed price, the credit applied, and the net blended $/1M at our expected consumption profile.

Best,
Sam Perez
Head of Product, Avery Labs
sam@avery.ai

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 11:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Internal: Avery Labs pricing path (suggested structure)

Jaz / Marcus — quick internal note following Sam’s reply. I put together a recommended discount path that we can present that hits their ~$70/1M target for expected volumes while protecting margin. See attached spreadsheet (pricing-bands.xlsx).

High-level proposal (internal math):
- List price (monthly billing, per 1M tokens):
  - 0–5M: $130/1M
  - 5–20M: $95/1M
  - 20M+: $80/1M
- 12-month committed-use discount: 25% off list for year 1 (applies to committed baseline).
- Startup incentive: $10,000 credit applied up front (applies to usage charges, first 3 months).
- Year 2 (if they extend to multi-year): an additional 10% off the committed price (effectively ~32.5% off list across years).

Example blended math (using their ramp and expected steady-state ~10M):
- Without incentives, blended list is ~ $102/1M.
- With 25% commit discount + $10k credit spread across first 3 months, blended comes to ~ $72–74/1M over the first 12 months (depends on ramp). That hits Sam’s target.

Risks / ask:
- Need a short (redwood) MSA; procurement will want SOC2 attestation (we have this) and a simple data handling exhibit.
- Confirm we can offer the $10k startup credit under standard startup program terms (marketing + reference optional).

If you want, I can build the one-pager with the line items and exact blended numbers for their ramp and send to Sam.

Ben Carter
Sr. Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com

Attachment: pricing-bands.xlsx (xlsx, 1 sheet)

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
To: Sam Perez <sam@avery.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Avery Labs Procurement <procurement@avery.ai>
Date: Thu, 21 Oct 2026 09:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Revised proposal: commitment tiers + startup credit (see attached)

Sam — thanks for the quick reply and for confirming the ramp. Per our internal discussion I’ve attached an updated one-page proposal (redwood-commitment-proposal-v2.pdf) that shows list vs committed pricing and the startup credit applied to your ramp. Key points up-front: 

1) Pricing summary (monthly, per 1M tokens)- List bands:
  - 0–5M: $130/1M
  - 5–20M: $95/1M
  - 20M+: $80/1M
- Committed (12-month firm baseline)
  - 25% off list for the committed baseline in year 1
  - If they sign a 24-month commitment at the same baseline, year 2 receives an extra 10% off the committed price (multi-year incentive).

2) Startup incentive
- $10,000 account credit applied to first invoices (expected to cover the largest portion of ramp months). No marketing/reference obligation required to qualify — standard startup program terms (we can provide the doc).

3) Blended example using your ramp (months 1–3 ramp, steady at 10M)- With 25% committed discount + $10k credit, blended $/1M tokens over first 12 months = approximately $73/1M (final depends on exact monthly consumption; spreadsheet attached shows three scenarios).

4) Next steps
- If that looks good, I’ll issue a redlined one-page commercial term sheet and a DocuSign link for the MSA + commitment appendix. Target dates per your ask: sign commercial terms by 2026-11-03, PO by 2026-11-10.
- Please confirm the committed baseline you want to lock (I used 10M tokens/month in the attached example).

Attachments: redwood-commitment-proposal-v2.pdf (pdf, 2 pages), redwood-msa.pdf (pdf, MSA template)

Thanks and happy to hop on a quick 15m call if you want to walk the numbers.

Best,

Jasmine Liu
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwood.com | (415) 555-0123
